name: outputschema-eval
author: Andre Cipriani Bandarra
description: TypeScript evaluation suite measuring the impact of WebMCP outputSchema on agent tool selection and parameter accuracy across single-turn and multi-turn conversations.

scripts.eval:without-output: npm run build && node dist/cli.js -t schemas/schema-without-output.json -e evals/evals.json -o .evals/without-output
scripts.eval:with-output: npm run build && node dist/cli.js -t schemas/schema-with-output.json -e evals/evals.json -o .evals/with-output
